description: The version combination the OurFairy v1 backend is built and tested against: the OurFairy integration branch plus exact commits of the dsh and rikkahub forks. A worktree obtains the same combination by branching from each repo integrationBranch tip and running scripts/combo.mjs verify.

ourfairy.note: Self repository: verify asserts the current worktree HEAD is the integration branch tip or an ancestor of it. Product modules live under backend/, launchers under scripts/.

dsh.note: productCommit is the fork integration branch tip. It carries durable session ownership, first-class delivery of a peer Session message, and the admission generalization for a registered second credential. All four requiredBuild commands must run: build:lib:host builds the CLI and host libraries, build:lib:client emits the client-face Node loader entries that the connection row imports, and build:native-system builds the flock addon the durable JSONL writer requires.

rikkahub.note: productCommit is the Android fork integration branch tip. It carries the presentation measurement as its own perf variant: the offline workloads run through the production RemoteChatState and RemoteTranscript, and a result reports whether the newest snapshot was applied and presented. The measurement does not ship in release.

backend.agentModelNote: The initial shared model selection this combination starts on. The bundle agent-default-model row and combo.json declare the same provider/model pair; the doctor bundle-agent-model check compares the two. MiniMax reuses the llm-pi-ai minimax-cn catalog route (1M context, adaptive thinking at max effort) and resolves MINIMAX_CN_API_KEY per request through the credential seam. The product chat runtime reads agentDefaultModel at each turn start, so a Phaethon-saved selection overrides this initial default without editing combo.json; the probe passes the pair explicitly because it creates its own Agent outside that runtime. The official DeepSeek route stays mounted but is not selected.
